candidates.claim: OT-facing port sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/5 is configured as a trunk rather than an access port in VLAN 10, and no approved VLAN set exists for it, so it is an unauthorized trunk.
candidates.remediation: Return GigabitEthernet1/0/5 to switchport mode access in VLAN 10, or document and approve the trunk and its VLAN set.

candidates.claim: The approved baseline has sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/5 as an access port in VLAN 10, but the current snapshot has it as a trunk, a deviation that must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change against approved change records and revert to access VLAN 10 unless the trunk is authorized.

candidates.claim: The rtr-01 EDGE_IN ACL permits tcp/443 from any source to the fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2 while fw-01 has the ASA HTTP (ASDM) server enabled, which exposes HTTPS device management to OUTSIDE contrary to the management policy that limits HTTPS/ASDM to MGMT on the mgmt interface.
candidates.remediation: Remove the tcp/443 permit to 203.0.113.2 from EDGE_IN and confirm that the ASA HTTP server is reachable only from MGMT on the mgmt interface.
